notes: It is clear from the above table that the highest Non-Plan expenditure was
reported from Uttar Pradesh (Rs.9581.3 lakhs) followed by Tamil Nadu (Rs.4844.4
lakhs) and Punjab (Rs.3596.8 lakhs). However, Kerala (Rs.1539.5 lakhs),
Meghalaya (Rs.129.8 lakhs), Sikkim (Rs.59 lakhs) and Delhi (Rs.3266.9 lakhs} are
the only State/UTs, where the expenditure exceeded their actual sanctioned
budget of Rs.1493.1 lakhs, Rs.109.4 lakhs, Rs.49.8 lakhs and Rs.3259.2 lakhs
respectively. The relevant details may be seen in Table 47.
